rationale: Third-party child injured on policyholder's premises due to dangerous condition (icy walkway); classic premises liability claim with injury to non-household member.
claim_summary: Third-party child (age 9) sustained a broken wrist after slipping on ice on policyholder's front walkway during an ice storm last week. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a premises liability claim with pediatric injury; covered under POL-1002 with $500k limit and $1k deductible.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.injury_description: Broken wrist from slip and fall on icy walkway
